manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Yannik until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
